details.description: Claude Sonnet 4 is Anthropic's mid-tier hybrid reasoning model, released May 22, 2025 as an upgrade to Claude Sonnet 3.7 with improvements in coding, reasoning, and instruction-following. It takes text and image input, offers both near-instant responses and an extended-thinking mode, and can use tools such as web search during that thinking. Anthropic retired Claude Sonnet 4 on its own Claude API on June 15, 2026 in favor of Claude Sonnet 4.6; Amazon Bedrock, which sets its own lifecycle, separately lists the model as deprecated with an October 14, 2026 end-of-life date.
advantages: Scores 72.7% on SWE-bench Verified for real-world software engineering tasks, per Anthropic's Claude 4 launch announcement.
Hybrid model offering both near-instant responses and an extended-thinking mode for deeper reasoning, per Anthropic.
Can use tools, such as web search, during extended thinking, alternating between reasoning and tool use, per Anthropic.
65% less likely to use shortcuts or loopholes on agentic tasks than Claude Sonnet 3.7, per Anthropic's launch announcement.
disadvantages: Retired on Anthropic's own Claude API on June 15, 2026; Anthropic recommends migrating to Claude Sonnet 4.6.
Amazon Bedrock separately lists Claude Sonnet 4 as deprecated, with an end-of-life date of October 14, 2026.
Anthropic's own launch announcement says Claude Opus 4 delivers sustained performance on long-running tasks requiring thousands of steps, dramatically outperforming all Sonnet models.
use_cases: User-facing AI assistants and high-volume tasks where practical efficiency matters, per Anthropic.
Agentic coding and software engineering tasks.
Research or workflows that alternate between extended thinking and tool use, such as web search, per Anthropic.

sources.title: Claude on Amazon Bedrock (Opus 4.6 and earlier)

notes: Catalog lists max_input_tokens as 1,000,000, but Anthropic's Bedrock docs state 'Other Claude models, including Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 4 (deprecated), have a 200k-token context window' on Amazon Bedrock; kept the catalog's value per instructions since it may reflect a different endpoint or beta context option. Anthropic's model-deprecations page retired claude-sonnet-4-20250514 from the Claude API on June 15, 2026 (already past today's date); its Bedrock legacy-endpoint table separately marks the model 'Deprecated' with Bedrock's own October 14, 2026 EOL date, which matches the catalog's deprecation_date.
